sentences.zh: 一个要求刺杀俄罗斯总统的碎片化命令。

sentences.en: Welcome back to The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《历史的余味》。

sentences.en: So, we're in the late summer of 218 BC.
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于公元前218年的夏末。

sentences.en: Hannibal has set off from Spain, across the Pyrenees, with this mighty army.
sentences.zh: 汉尼拔带着这支强大的军队从西班牙出发，穿过了比利牛斯山脉。

sentences.en: And he has crossed into Gaul.
sentences.zh: 他已经进入了高卢。

sentences.en: And Tom, by the time the summer is nearing its end, he is halfway to Italy.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，当夏天快要结束时，他已经走了一半路程到达意大利了。

sentences.en: But by this point, he's already started to lose a lot of his men, hasn't he?
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，他已经开始损失很多人手了，不是吗？

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Why are they falling away?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们会不断减员？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, it's estimated by ancient sources.
sentences.zh: 据古代文献估计。

sentences.en: And I think they're generally held to be pretty reliable.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们通常被认为是相当可靠的。

sentences.en: So, the 90,000 who had infantry, who'd left New Carthage, about 50,000 remain.
sentences.zh: 离开新迦太基时的9万名步兵，现在只剩下约5万人了。

sentences.en: And of the 12,000 cavalry, about 9,000 remain.
sentences.zh: 而1.2万名骑兵中，只剩下约9千人。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is that the going has been quite tough.
sentences.zh: 原因在于这一路走来非常艰难。

sentences.en: So, Carthage's rule extends to the Ebro.
sentences.zh: 迦太基的统治范围延伸到了埃布罗河。

sentences.en: But from the Ebro up to the Pyrenees, it's quite a tough journey.
sentences.zh: 但从埃布罗河到比利牛斯山脉，这是一段相当艰难的旅程。

sentences.en: So, they've got to defeat people along their way.
sentences.zh: 他们必须在途中击败沿途的人。

sentences.en: There's obviously casualties.
sentences.zh: 显然会有伤亡。

sentences.en: Then you need to set up garrisons.
sentences.zh: 然后你需要建立驻军。

sentences.en: There have probably also been desertions.
sentences.zh: 可能还有逃兵。

sentences.en: You know, if there are people from Iberia who don't particularly want to go, they can just kind of melt away.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果有一些伊比利亚人不想去，他们随时可以溜走。

sentences.en: And this is kind of potentially alarming, not just because the numbers have been depleted, but also because, as you said, it's now kind of later than Hannibal would ideally want.
sentences.zh: 这可能令人担忧，不仅是因为人数减少了，还因为正如你所说，现在的时间比汉尼拔理想中的要晚。

sentences.en: It's a kind of invading, you know, Russia in early September kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 这就像是在九月初入侵俄罗斯一样。

sentences.en: Probably not what you want to be doing.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是你想做的事情。

sentences.en: However, the reason that Hannibal carries on isn't just kind of mad recklessness.
sentences.zh: 然而，汉尼拔继续前进的原因不仅仅是疯狂的鲁莽。

sentences.en: It's because he still has confidence in his ability to execute his plan.
sentences.zh: 这是因为他仍然对自己执行计划的能力充满信心。

sentences.en: The forces that he has with him now, those who have not deserted, those who have not been kind of set up to secure his communication links with Spain,
sentences.zh: 他现在拥有的部队，那些没有逃跑的，那些没有被派去保卫他与西班牙通讯联络线的部队，

sentences.en: these are the best of the beSt.
sentences.zh: 这些是精锐中的精锐。

sentences.en: These are absolutely committed and loyal to him.
sentences.zh: 他们对他绝对忠诚，坚定不移。

sentences.en: And so he says, let's go for it.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，我们出发吧。

sentences.en: So he's crossed the Pyrenees.
sentences.zh: 于是他穿过了比利牛斯山脉。

sentences.en: He's now into southern Gaul, southern France.
sentences.zh: 他现在进入了高卢南部，也就是法国南部。

sentences.en: And there are two immediate challenges confronting him.
sentences.zh: 他面临着两个直接的挑战。

sentences.en: The first is, where are the Romans?
sentences.zh: 第一个是，罗马人在哪里？

sentences.en: So what's happened to Scipio?
sentences.zh: 西庇阿发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Scipio's got, you know, he's got his legions.
sentences.zh: 西庇阿有他的军团。

sentences.en: He's got his cavalry.
sentences.zh: 他有他的骑兵。

sentences.en: He's got his ships.
sentences.zh: 他有他的船只。

sentences.en: Hannibal knows that he'll be sailing westwards.
sentences.zh: 汉尼拔知道他会向西航行。

sentences.en: Will he be going to Sardinia?
sentences.zh: 他会去撒丁岛吗？

sentences.en: Will he be going to Spain?
sentences.zh: 他会去西班牙吗？

sentences.en: Will he be going to South Gaul?
sentences.zh: 他会去高卢南部吗？

sentences.en: You know, what's he going to be doing?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他到底要做什么？

sentences.en: No news of him as yet.
sentences.zh: 目前还没有关于他的消息。

sentences.en: Then there's the other issue, which is how do you cross the river Rhone, which is massive?
sentences.zh: 然后是另一个问题，那就是如何跨越罗纳河，那条河非常巨大。

sentences.en: There are no bridges.
sentences.zh: 那里没有桥梁。

sentences.en: It's a real problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个真正的问题。

sentences.en: It's a very, very broad river and its lower reaches are controlled by the Greek city of Massilia.
sentences.zh: 那是一条非常非常宽的河流，其下游由希腊城市马赛控制。

sentences.en: So this is what will become Marseille.
sentences.zh: 这就是后来成为马赛的地方。

sentences.en: And Massilia is an ally of Rome.
sentences.zh: 而马西利亚是罗马的盟友。

sentences.en: And so Hannibal can't rely on the Massilians to allow him to use their bridges.
sentences.zh: 所以汉尼拔不能指望马西利亚人让他使用他们的桥梁。

sentences.en: So he has to go upriver to find a suitable crossing point.
sentences.zh: 因此他必须向上游寻找一个合适的渡河点。

sentences.en: And this is very difficult because it's the land around the lower reaches of the Rhone, a kind of very, it's a combination of marsh and scrub.
sentences.zh: 这非常困难，因为罗纳河下游周围的地势非常复杂，结合了沼泽和灌木丛。

sentences.en: So not pleasant at all.
sentences.zh: 所以一点也不好走。

sentences.en: So they keep going up the river Rhone for four days from the sea.
sentences.zh: 于是他们沿着罗纳河向上游行进了四天，远离了大海。

sentences.en: And finally, he arrives at a place where he thinks, yeah, this might be possible.
sentences.zh: 最后，他到达了一个地方，心想，嗯，这或许可行。

sentences.en: We could probably do it, make a crossing here.
sentences.zh: 我们大概能在这里渡河。

sentences.en: And it's probably near the site of what a century later will be the Roman foundation of Arles.
sentences.zh: 这可能就在一个世纪后罗马建立的阿尔勒遗址附近。

sentences.en: Very handsome city.
sentences.zh: 那是一座非常漂亮的城市。

sentences.en: Fantastic amphitheatre.
sentences.zh: 有很棒的圆形剧场。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So very, very Roman, but there's no, nothing there at this point.
sentences.zh: 非常、非常罗马，但在当时那里什么都没有。

sentences.en: And it's still pretty tricky because the river is still very wide.
sentences.zh: 而且情况依然很棘手，因为河面依然非常宽阔。

sentences.en: The current is quite swift.
sentences.zh: 水流相当湍急。

sentences.en: And worst of all, on the opposite side, there is a Gallic tribe called the Volcai who have not pocketed Hannibal's gold.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的是，在对岸有一个叫沃尔卡伊的部落，他们没有收下汉尼拔的黄金。

sentences.en: If they have pocketed Hannibal's gold, they have betrayed their promise that they will give him a safe crossing.
sentences.zh: 如果他们收了汉尼拔的黄金，就等于背弃了让他们安全渡河的承诺。

sentences.en: And they have massed along the far bank and are determined not to give the Carthaginians a welcome at all when they make the crossing.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在对岸集结，决心在迦太基人渡河时绝不给他们好脸色看。

sentences.en: So these are real challenges.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是真正的挑战。

sentences.en: And we have, fortunately, what is probably an eyewitness account, probably from the Spartan Sausalus who was accompanying Hannibal on his trip.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我们有一份很可能是亲历者的记录，大概来自陪伴汉尼拔出征的斯巴达人索西路斯。

sentences.en: And if it is Sausalus, he writes, Hannibal used every resource to make friends with the natives living by the bank.
sentences.zh: 如果确实是索西路斯，他写道，汉尼拔动用了所有资源与住在河边的当地人交朋友。

sentences.en: And he bought up all their canoes and boats, of which there were a large number, since many of the inhabitants of the Rhone Valley are engaged in seaborne trade.
sentences.zh: 他买下了他们所有的独木舟和船只，数量很多，因为罗纳河谷的许多居民都从事海上贸易。

sentences.en: He also obtained from them the kind of logs which are suitable for building canoes, so that within two days he had mustered an innumerable quantity of small ferryboats.
sentences.zh: 他还从他们那里获得了适合建造独木舟的木材，所以两天之内他就凑齐了数不清的小渡船。

sentences.en: And you can see there that on this side of the bank, clearly his gold and his agents have worked because he's being provided with the wherewithal to get across the river.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，在这一侧的岸边，显然他的黄金和代理人起了作用，因为他获得了渡河所需的物资。

sentences.en: But he's still got this problem of the Volki.
sentences.zh: 但他仍然面临沃尔卡伊人的问题。

sentences.en: How are you going to deal with them?
sentences.zh: 你打算怎么对付他们？

sentences.en: So he waits.
sentences.zh: 所以他等待着。

sentences.en: Five days pass since he's arrived on the bank.
sentences.zh: 他到达岸边已经五天了。

sentences.en: The Volki lined up on the far bank.
sentences.zh: 沃尔卡伊人在对岸列阵。

sentences.en: And then on the morning of the sixth day, Hannibal's standing on the bank and he's looking upriver.
sentences.zh: 到了第六天早上，汉尼拔站在岸边望着上游。

sentences.en: And he sees rising from there, from a point upriver, a plume of smoke.
sentences.zh: 他看到上游某处升起了一缕烟雾。

sentences.en: And this is clearly a signal because he then gives orders for his troops to start making the crossing.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个信号，因为他随即下令部队开始渡河。

sentences.en: And again, to quote this eyewitness, the large boats were placed the furthest upstream and directly against the current and the lighter ones below them,
sentences.zh: 再次引用那位亲历者的话，大船被安置在最上游，直接抵御水流，较轻的船只排在它们后面，

sentences.en: so that the heavier craft should absorb the main force of the water and the canoes be less exposed to risk in crossing.
sentences.zh: 这样较重的船只就能吸收水流的主要冲击力，让独木舟在渡河时减少风险。

sentences.en: So very, very kind of sensible.
sentences.zh: 所以这非常、非常明智。

sentences.en: And the horses have to swim on either side of the large boats with a man on each side kind of keeping hold of the reins to stop them from kind of being swept away on the currents.
sentences.zh: 马匹必须在大船的两侧游泳，每侧各有一人牵着缰绳，防止它们被水流冲走。

sentences.en: And it's all very exciting.
sentences.zh: 这一切非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: The boats are racing each other.
sentences.zh: 船只在竞相前进。

sentences.en: There's kind of lots of cheering, lots of military banter, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，到处都是欢呼声和军中的调侃。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, of course, the Volki are waiting.
sentences.zh: 当然，与此同时，沃尔卡伊人正在等待。

sentences.en: So very, very tense.
sentences.zh: 所以气氛非常、非常紧张。

sentences.en: It's what is going to happen when the prows of the Carthaginian boats and canoes start crunching up against the gravel of the far shore.
sentences.zh: 当迦太基船只和独木舟的船头开始撞击对岸的砾石时，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Exciting.
sentences.zh: 令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Very exciting.
sentences.zh: 非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Well, what happens is a stunning twist of the kind that will increasingly come to be associated with Hannibal's campaigns.
sentences.zh: 嗯，发生的是一个令人惊叹的转折，这种转折以后会越来越多地与汉尼拔的战役联系在一起。

sentences.en: Because just as the Carthaginian vessels start landing on the far bank, the Volki are alarmed to hear on their right flank, a sudden pounding of hooves and wild Numidian war cries.
sentences.zh: 因为就在迦太基船只开始在对岸登陆时，沃尔卡伊人惊恐地听到右翼传来一阵急促的马蹄声和狂野的努米底亚战吼。

sentences.en: Oh, my word.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Because what Hannibal has done is he has sent his Numidian cavalry, the best light cavalry in the world, upriver to make a secret crossing higher up.
sentences.zh: 因为汉尼拔所做的是，他派出了他那世界上最精锐的轻骑兵——努米底亚骑兵，向上游行进，在更远的地方秘密渡河。

sentences.en: Because, of course, they can gallop up there, make the crossing and then gallop back down.
sentences.zh: 因为他们当然可以骑马赶到那里，完成渡河，然后再疾驰回来。

sentences.en: And that plume of smoke that he'd seen was the signal that the Numidians were ready to pounce.
sentences.zh: 而他看到的那缕烟雾就是努米底亚人准备突袭的信号。

sentences.en: And the Volki are taken completely by surprise.
sentences.zh: 沃尔卡伊人完全被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: Their camp is burnt.
sentences.zh: 他们的营地被烧毁了。

sentences.en: They run away.
sentences.zh: 他们逃跑了。

sentences.en: Anyway, the Carthaginian army is able to forge a bridgehead and the men are able to get across.
sentences.zh: 总之，迦太基军队得以建立了一个桥头堡，士兵们得以渡过河去。

sentences.en: And you know how good I am on bridges, bridges going too far and all that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道我有多擅长讲桥梁的故事，什么桥梁走得太远之类的。

sentences.en: Here, there's no need for a bridge because they've got rafts and boats and things.
sentences.zh: 在这里，不需要桥，因为他们有木筏、船只之类的东西。

sentences.en: There is, of course, one final challenge, which is how do you get an elephant onto a boat?
sentences.zh: 当然，还有一个最后的挑战，那就是如何把大象弄上船？

sentences.en: Not something I've ever really contemplated.
sentences.zh: 这不是我曾经考虑过的事情。

sentences.en: But how do you do it?
sentences.zh: 但你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: I'm curious.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇。

sentences.en: Well, you build a succession of massive rafts and you then lash them together and you kind of push them out into the river.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你建造一连串巨大的木筏，把它们绑在一起，然后把它们推入河中。

sentences.en: And then you cover them with earth so that they seem to just be part of the river bank so that the elephants don't realize as they're being led from the bank onto the rafts that they're moving onto something that is floating on the river.
sentences.zh: 然后你在上面覆盖泥土，让它们看起来就像河岸的一部分，这样当大象从岸上被引导到木筏上时，它们就不会意识到自己正走在漂浮在河面上的东西上。

sentences.en: And then having done that, you get them onto the kind of the far rafts.
sentences.zh: 做完这些后，你把它们弄到远处的木筏上。

sentences.en: You cut the moorings.
sentences.zh: 你解开缆绳。

sentences.en: The rafts start going across the river.
sentences.zh: 木筏开始横渡河流。

sentences.en: And the elephants at this point, they panic, but they're calmed by their mahouts, the guys who steer them.
sentences.zh: 此时大象会惊慌失措，但会被它们的驯象师——那些驾驭它们的人安抚下来。

sentences.en: And some of these are thrown off into the river and they drown, which is very sad.
sentences.zh: 其中一些大象被甩进河里淹死了，这非常令人难过。

sentences.en: The elephants, all 34 of them, they make it across.
sentences.zh: 大象，全部34头，都成功渡过了河。

sentences.en: Oh, that's good news because no one really cares about the mahouts, but everybody cares about the elephants.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是个好消息，因为没人真正在乎驯象师，但每个人都在乎大象。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So this is great drama.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场精彩的戏码。

sentences.en: They've made their way across the Rhône.
sentences.zh: 他们已经渡过了罗纳河。

sentences.en: That's another physical barrier crossed.
sentences.zh: 又跨越了一道物理障碍。

sentences.en: And then the next day, there's further drama because news reaches Hannibal that Scipio and his legions have docked in Massilia, in Marseille.
sentences.zh: 第二天，剧情进一步发展，因为消息传到汉尼拔耳中，西庇阿和他的军团已经在马西利亚，也就是马赛靠岸了。

sentences.en: And so Hannibal sends a squad of Numidians down the river to reconnoiter to find out the lay of the land.
sentences.zh: 于是汉尼拔派出一队努米底亚人沿河而下进行侦察，以了解地形。

sentences.en: Scipio has sent a squad of horsemen up the river to find out what Hannibal is doing.
sentences.zh: 西庇阿也派出一队骑兵沿河而上，去打探汉尼拔在做什么。

sentences.en: The two forces of cavalry meet.
sentences.zh: 两支骑兵部队相遇了。

sentences.en: The Numidians get the worst of it, but most of them manage to get away.
sentences.zh: 努米底亚人吃了亏，但大多数人设法逃脱了。

sentences.en: And they come back to Hannibal and say, the Romans are, you know, they're just down the river.
sentences.zh: 他们回到汉尼拔身边说，罗马人，你知道，他们就在下游。

sentences.en: What do you want to do?
sentences.zh: 你想怎么做？

sentences.en: And this is a crucial decision for Hannibal.
sentences.zh: 这对汉尼拔来说是一个至关重要的决定。

sentences.en: Does he fight the Romans in Gaul or does he carry on over the Alps?
sentences.zh: 他是要在高卢与罗马人作战，还是继续翻越阿尔卑斯山？

sentences.en: He knows that he outnumbers Scipio.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己的兵力超过西庇阿。

sentences.en: Scipio doesn't have as many troops and also Hannibal would back himself to defeat Scipio, I think.
sentences.zh: 西庇阿的部队没那么多，而且我认为汉尼拔也有信心击败西庇阿。

sentences.en: But the danger, obviously, is that if he fights a battle and it's already getting late in the summer, then it will be very difficult for him, having done that,
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的危险是，如果他打一场仗，而且现在已经是夏末了，那么在打完仗之后，

sentences.en: to advance into Italy and secure winter quarters before the end of the campaigning season.
sentences.zh: 他将很难在作战季节结束前进入意大利并确保冬营地。

sentences.en: And he can't risk being stranded in hostile territory that isn't even Italy all winter.
sentences.zh: 他不能冒着整个冬天被困在敌对领土（甚至还不是意大利）的风险。

sentences.en: I mean, that would be a disaster for him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那对他来说将是一场灾难。

sentences.en: What would be so terrible about being in Gaul, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，待在高卢有什么可怕的呢？

sentences.en: Because Gaul, would he not be the master of Gaul then?
sentences.zh: 因为高卢，到那时他不就是高卢的主人了吗？

sentences.en: No, he wouldn't be the master of Gaul because he's not interested in conquering it.
sentences.zh: 不，他不会成为高卢的主人，因为他没兴趣征服那里。

sentences.en: His reason for going to Italy is to get the backing of the subject peoples there to Rome.
sentences.zh: 他去意大利的原因是为了获得那里受罗马统治的民族的支持。

sentences.en: So he needs to be on the spot, his agents working, getting the Gauls in northern Italy, hopefully getting some of the cities in lower down Italy to start moving over to him.
sentences.zh: 所以他需要亲临现场，让他的代理人开展工作，争取意大利北部的高卢人，希望让意大利南部的一些城市开始倒向他。

sentences.en: Because if that if that doesn't work, then the whole strategy is not going to work.
sentences.zh: 因为如果那行不通，那么整个战略就不会奏效。

sentences.en: You know, he can't defeat Rome on his own.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他无法独自击败罗马。

sentences.en: He needs to win, get Italian and Gaelic backing.
sentences.zh: 他需要获胜，获得意大利和高卢人的支持。

sentences.en: So he has to be physically on Italian soil.
sentences.zh: 所以他必须亲自踏上意大利的土地。

sentences.en: And so essentially this makes his mind up for him.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上让他下定了决心。

sentences.en: But what finally I think kind of sways him is that ambassadors come from a Gallic tribe called the Boi, who live on the far side of the Alps.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最终让他动摇的是，来自阿尔卑斯山另一侧一个叫波伊部落的高卢使者来了。

sentences.en: So in Italy, he was subject to the Romans and they're desperate for his support.
sentences.zh: 在意大利，他们受罗马人统治，他们迫切需要他的支持。

sentences.en: And this is a really good sign because it suggests that his strategy has a good prospect of working.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的迹象，因为它表明他的战略有很好的成功前景。

sentences.en: And the Boi, these Gallic envoys, they say, we can show you a way up over the Alps so that you won't have to, you know, go on the Roman roads that skirt the Alps.
sentences.zh: 波伊人，这些高卢使者说，我们可以为你指引一条翻越阿尔卑斯山的道路，这样你就不用走那些绕过阿尔卑斯山的罗马道路了。

sentences.en: You'll be able to come down in the Romans rear.
sentences.zh: 你将能够出现在罗马人的后方。

sentences.en: And of course, this is what Hercules had done.
sentences.zh: 当然，这就是赫拉克勒斯曾经做过的事。

sentences.en: And I think Hannibal recognizes that the propagandistic impact of taking his army, taking his elephants over the Alps, of emerging in the Romans rear is going to be stupefying.
sentences.zh: 我认为汉尼拔意识到，带着他的军队、带着他的大象翻越阿尔卑斯山，并出现在罗马人后方的宣传效果将是惊人的。

sentences.en: And again, this has to be part of his strategy because he has to overwhelm and awe the Italians as well as the Romans.
sentences.zh: 同样，这必须是他战略的一部分，因为他不仅要压倒罗马人，还要让意大利人感到敬畏。

sentences.en: He needs to win them over.
sentences.zh: 他需要赢得他们的支持。

sentences.en: So he thinks, yeah, let's go for it.
sentences.zh: 所以他想，好吧，干吧。

sentences.en: Hell of a risk though, Tom.
sentences.zh: 但这可是个天大的冒险，汤姆。

sentences.en: I mean, hell of a risk.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，天大的冒险。

sentences.en: It absolutely is a risk.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个冒险。

sentences.en: But he's the heir of Hercules.
sentences.zh: 但他可是赫拉克勒斯的继承人。

sentences.en: He's a gambler.
sentences.zh: 他是个赌徒。

sentences.en: But it's not an unreasonable gamble, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这不是一个不合理的赌博。

sentences.en: I mean, he's playing for high stakes, but it's not a holy mad gamble.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在下大赌注，但这并不是完全疯狂的赌博。

sentences.en: And so three days after Scipio's cavalry have had the brush with the Numidians, Scipio himself at the head of his army arrives at the place where Hannibal had crossed the Rhone.
sentences.zh: 于是，在西庇阿的骑兵与努米底亚人发生冲突的三天后，西庇阿本人率领他的军队抵达了汉尼拔渡过罗纳河的地方。

sentences.en: And he discovers that the Carthaginians have gone.
sentences.zh: 他发现迦太基人已经走了。

sentences.en: And to quote Polybius, this Greek historian who you mentioned earlier,
sentences.zh: 引用你之前提到的那位希腊历史学家波利比乌斯的话，

sentences.en: Scipio was astounded to find that the enemy had already pressed on as he had felt certain that they would never venture to advance into Italy by this route,
sentences.zh: 西庇阿惊讶地发现敌人已经继续前进了，因为他确信他们绝不敢冒险走这条路线进入意大利，

sentences.en: partly because of their numbers and partly because of the fickle nature of the barbarians who inhabited the region.
sentences.zh: 部分是因为他们的人数，部分是因为居住在该地区的野蛮人反复无常的本性。

sentences.en: However, when he learned that they had taken this risk, he hurried back to his ships and immediately began to embark his forces.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他得知他们冒了这个险时，他匆忙回到船上，立即开始让部队登船。

sentences.en: So he's going to take his ships back to Italy so that he will be ready to meet Hannibal when Hannibal comes down from the Alps, if he comes down from the Alps.
sentences.zh: 所以他要把船开回意大利，这样当汉尼拔从阿尔卑斯山下来时，他就能准备好迎接他，如果他真的能从阿尔卑斯山下来的话。

sentences.en: So Hannibal has gone up into the Alps.
sentences.zh: 所以汉尼拔已经进入了阿尔卑斯山。

sentences.en: Now, here we come to the kind of question that military historians and people of that ilk spend decades investigating.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们遇到了那种军事历史学家和这类人花了几十年时间研究的问题。

sentences.en: They really care.
sentences.zh: 他们真的很在乎。

sentences.en: You know, it's like the classic thing we said in our 1066 series, which side of the field were they standing on?
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我们在1066系列中说的经典问题，他们站在战场的哪一边？

sentences.en: And some people really care about this.
sentences.zh: 有些人真的很在乎这个。

sentences.en: And I think one of the defining things about the rest is history is that ultimately we couldn't care less.
sentences.zh: 我认为《历史的其余部分》的一个定义性特征是，归根结底我们一点也不在乎。

sentences.en: What route he takes to the Alps.
sentences.zh: 他走哪条路去阿尔卑斯山。

sentences.en: He goes up into the Alps anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正他还是进了阿尔卑斯山。

sentences.en: And there are all kinds of strange things that people have done, particularly to do with horse manure, that they study to try to work out which way Hannibal went.
sentences.zh: 人们做了各种各样奇怪的事情，特别是关于马粪的研究，试图找出汉尼拔走了哪条路。

sentences.en: Yeah, so there's a kind of microbe which is found in horse and interesting elephant manure and it can survive for thousands of years in soil.
sentences.zh: 是的，有一种微生物存在于马粪和有趣的大象粪便中，它可以在土壤中存活数千年。

sentences.en: So there are scientists going through mountain passes in the Alps looking for basically for elephant shit.
sentences.zh: 所以有科学家在阿尔卑斯山的山口中穿行，基本上就是在寻找大象屎。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the Alps right now, there's a man on his hands and knees desperately trying to find, you know, incredibly old horse manure.
sentences.zh: 现在阿尔卑斯山的某个地方，有一个人正跪在地上，拼命地试图找到那种极其古老的马粪。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Personally, I don't think it particularly matters which route Hannibal takes, the precise route.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我不认为汉尼拔走哪条路，确切的路线，有什么特别重要的。

sentences.en: And you don't need to know to feel awed by the scale of what he attempts.
sentences.zh: 你不需要知道这些，也能对他的尝试规模感到敬畏。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So when Vin Diesel takes you on as the historical consultant for his film and you say, oh, it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 所以当范·迪塞尔聘请你担任他电影的历史顾问时，你说，哦，那不重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, you can do whatever you like.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可以随心所欲地拍。

sentences.en: And I think it doesn't matter because it doesn't matter which precisely they are, because the basic outline we know we can be fairly confident is accurate.
sentences.zh: 我认为这不重要，是因为无论具体是哪条路都不重要，因为我们知道的基本轮廓可以相当肯定地说是准确的。

sentences.en: Because, again, I think it derives from eyewitness accounts.
sentences.zh: 因为，同样，我认为它源于亲历者的记录。

sentences.en: And again, chiefly this guy, Saucylus of Sparta, Hannibal's Greek tutor.
sentences.zh: 同样，主要是这个家伙，斯巴达的索西路斯，汉尼拔的希腊导师。

sentences.en: And they were used by this guy, Polybius, who we've already mentioned, this Greek historian who is by far the best and most reliable historian of Hannibal's campaigns.
sentences.zh: 他们被我们之前提到的波利比乌斯所使用，这位希腊历史学家是迄今为止关于汉尼拔战役最优秀、最可靠的历史学家。

sentences.en: And he himself went to the Alps.
sentences.zh: 他本人也去过阿尔卑斯山。

sentences.en: He tried to trace Hannibal's route.
sentences.zh: 他试图追踪汉尼拔的路线。

sentences.en: So Polybius, by the standards of ancient history, certainly compared to Livy, is very reliable.
sentences.zh: 所以，以古代历史的标准来看，尤其是与李维相比，波利比乌斯确实非常可靠。

sentences.en: And so we will be drawing on Polybius's account of Hannibal's crossing the Alps, essentially, to tell the story of what then happens.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们基本上将借鉴波利比乌斯关于汉尼拔翻越阿尔卑斯山的记载，来讲述接下来发生的故事。

sentences.en: So according to Polybius, Hannibal's crossed the Rhone and he continues kind of northwards along its eastern bank.
sentences.zh: 根据波利比乌斯的说法，汉尼拔渡过罗纳河后，继续沿着东岸向北行进。

sentences.en: So he's still heading upwards into Gaul.
sentences.zh: 所以他仍在向高卢深处进发。

sentences.en: And four days after leaving the crossing point,
sentences.zh: 在离开渡口四天后，

sentences.en: he arrives in a territory where there's a kind of fratricidal squabble between two brothers who were trying to make themselves king of this tribe.
sentences.zh: 他抵达了一片领地，那里正发生着一场手足相残的争斗，两个兄弟都在争夺该部落的王位。

sentences.en: Hannibal backs one of the two brothers, puts him on the throne of the tribe and wins the gratitude of the victor, unsurprisingly.
sentences.zh: 汉尼拔支持了其中一位兄弟，将其扶上部落王位，不出所料，他赢得了胜利者的感激。

sentences.en: And so Hannibal is then able to rest his men, to source food, to source new weapons, to get Alpine clothing, you know,
sentences.zh: 于是，汉尼拔得以让部下休整，补充食物、获取新武器、置办阿尔卑斯山区的服装，你知道的，

sentences.en: go to the Alpine shops and get ski gear and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 去阿尔卑斯山的商店买滑雪装备之类的东西。

sentences.en: And then having done that, he then swings eastwards towards the Alps.
sentences.zh: 做完这些后，他便转向东方，朝阿尔卑斯山进发。

sentences.en: And it's here that he first runs into trouble because he is now passing into the lands of a very hostile and very aggressive Gallic tribe called the Allobroges.
sentences.zh: 就在这里，他第一次遇到了麻烦，因为他现在进入了一个非常敌对且极具侵略性的高卢部落——阿洛布罗基人的领地。

sentences.en: And to begin with, because the Allobroges are terrified of the Carthaginian cavalry and elephants, they merely shadow the intruders.
sentences.zh: 起初，由于阿洛布罗基人对迦太基的骑兵和象群感到恐惧，他们只是远远地尾随这些入侵者。

sentences.en: So you can imagine Hannibal and his men riding along and looking up and seeing shadowy figures of Gallic horsemen up on the heights.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象一下，汉尼拔和他的部下骑马前行，抬头望去，能看到高处有高卢骑兵的阴影。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then 10 days into his eastwards march from the Rhone, they start to climb and ahead of them lie the Alps.
sentences.zh: 但从罗纳河出发向东行进10天后，他们开始攀登，前方就是阿尔卑斯山。

sentences.en: And Polybius describes the Alps as seeming to rise above the landscape like a walled citadel above a city.
sentences.zh: 波利比乌斯形容阿尔卑斯山仿佛矗立在城市之上的城墙堡垒，高耸于地平线之上。

sentences.en: So this sense of mighty natural battlements blocking their path.
sentences.zh: 这给人一种强大的天然屏障阻挡在他们面前的感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, very, very intimidating.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常、非常令人畏惧。

sentences.en: And as they climb following the road, so they find that they're being funneled along a valley.
sentences.zh: 当他们沿着道路攀登时，发现自己被引入了一条山谷。

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, you know, to climb the Alps, you almost inevitably going to be find yourself funneling along a valley.
sentences.zh: 显然，你知道，要翻越阿尔卑斯山，几乎不可避免地会发现自己被挤在山谷中行进。

sentences.en: And the more it closes in, so obviously the longer Hannibal's line starts to become, because there's less and less space for people to march abreaSt.
sentences.zh: 山谷越狭窄，汉尼拔的队伍自然就拉得越长，因为供人们并排前进的空间越来越小。

sentences.en: So ultimately, it's maybe five miles, six miles long.
sentences.zh: 最终，队伍可能拉长到了五六英里。

sentences.en: And in due course, the valley tapers and Hannibal finds himself at the gateways of what is now a very narrow gorge.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，山谷逐渐收窄，汉尼拔发现自己来到了一个非常狭窄的峡谷入口处。

sentences.en: And unsurprisingly, he pauses here because narrow gorges and hostile tribesmen are not a good combination.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，他在这里停了下来，因为狭窄的峡谷和敌对的部落民绝非好组合。

sentences.en: And of course, Hannibal is a great man for intelligence, so he sent scouts ahead of him.
sentences.zh: 当然，汉尼拔非常重视情报，所以他提前派出了侦察兵。

sentences.en: And these scouts now come back and they bring very alarming news,
sentences.zh: 这些侦察兵现在回来了，带回了非常惊人的消息，

sentences.en: namely that the Alibrogues have taken up position along the heights overlooking the gorge because it's a perfect spot for an ambush.
sentences.zh: 即阿洛布罗基人已经在俯瞰峡谷的高地上布防，因为这是伏击的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: And Polybius comments, if the Alibrogues had only kept their plan secret, they would have completely destroyed the Carthaginian army.
sentences.zh: 波利比乌斯评论说，如果阿洛布罗基人能保守住他们的计划，他们本可以彻底摧毁迦太基军队。

sentences.en: But they haven't because Hannibal is too good a man at sourcing intelligence for that to happen.
sentences.zh: 但他们没能做到，因为汉尼拔在获取情报方面太出色了，这种事不可能发生。

sentences.en: And fortunately, as ever, Hannibal has a stratagem.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，一如既往，汉尼拔有锦囊妙计。

sentences.en: So as soon as it's dark, he gives orders for masses of campfires to be lit all over the kind of the terrain that the army is occupying to make a bigger show as possible.
sentences.zh: 天一黑，他就下令在军队驻扎的整个区域点燃大量的营火，尽可能制造出庞大的声势。

sentences.en: And so the Alibrogues see this, they assume, OK, well, they've bedded down for the night.
sentences.zh: 阿洛布罗基人看到这些，便认为：好吧，他们已经安营扎寨过夜了。

sentences.en: We don't need to worry about this.
sentences.zh: 我们不必担心这个。

sentences.en: And so they clock off and go back home for the night.
sentences.zh: 于是他们收兵回家过夜去了。

sentences.en: Hannibal, meanwhile, has a crack squad of handpicked men.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，汉尼拔拥有一支精挑细选的突击队。

sentences.en: And up they go into the heights and they seize control of the very heights that the Alibrogues had been occupying.
sentences.zh: 他们登上高地，夺取了阿洛布罗基人之前占据的制高点。

sentences.en: And this means that when the Alibrogues come back in the morning, oh, no, duh, we've been tricked by this great general.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当阿洛布罗基人在早晨回来时，会惊呼：噢，不，天哪，我们被这位伟大的将军耍了。

sentences.en: And obviously, as Polybius says, this means that Hannibal has spared his army from the absolute worst of the ambush that otherwise would have happened.
sentences.zh: 显然，正如波利比乌斯所说，这意味着汉尼拔让他的军队免于遭受本可能发生的最惨烈的伏击。

sentences.en: But it doesn't mean that that the Carthaginian army is entirely safe because essentially the baggage train is just too tempting.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着迦太基军队完全安全，因为本质上，辎重队实在太诱人了。

sentences.en: And so various warriors start kind of making swoops down, pouncing down.
sentences.zh: 于是，各种战士开始俯冲而下，发动突袭。

sentences.en: And Polybius has a very vivid account of what it was like.
sentences.zh: 波利比乌斯对当时的情景有着非常生动的描述。

sentences.en: He says the road leading up to the pass was not only narrow and uneven, but flanked with precipices.
sentences.zh: 他说，通往山口的道路不仅狭窄崎岖，而且两侧都是悬崖。

sentences.en: And so the least movement or disorder in the line caused many of the animals to be forced over the edge with their loads.
sentences.zh: 因此，队伍中哪怕最轻微的移动或混乱，都会导致许多牲畜连同货物一起被挤下悬崖。

sentences.en: So these aren't the elephants.
sentences.zh: 这些不是大象。

sentences.en: It's the mules and also the horses and the pack animals.
sentences.zh: 是骡子，还有马和驮畜。

sentences.en: And Polybius writes that in their fear, they would wheel around and collide with the baggage mules.
sentences.zh: 波利比乌斯写道，它们在恐惧中转身乱撞，与驮运辎重的骡子相撞。

sentences.en: These are the cavalry horses.
sentences.zh: 这些是骑兵的马。

sentences.en: While others rushing on ahead would thrust aside anything that stood in their way on the narrow path and so threw the whole line into disarray.
sentences.zh: 而其他向前冲的牲畜则推开狭窄小路上挡路的一切，导致整个队伍陷入混乱。

sentences.en: So you're starting to get men falling off the precipice as well.
sentences.zh: 所以你也开始看到有人从悬崖上掉下去了。

sentences.en: Ah, splat.
sentences.zh: 啊，啪叽。

sentences.en: Is that what the noise they make?
sentences.zh: 那是它们发出的声音吗？

sentences.en: That's exactly what it sounded like.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实就是那样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But fortunately, Hannibal is up on the heights.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，汉尼拔在高地上。

sentences.en: He's got his elite squad of hand-picked men.
sentences.zh: 他有他那支精挑细选的精英小队。

sentences.en: They're able to swoop down and stabilise the situation to inflict slaughter on the Allabrogues who are doing the ambush.
sentences.zh: 他们能够俯冲而下，稳定局势，并对进行伏击的阿洛布罗基人进行屠杀。

sentences.en: And so finally, when they emerge from the gorge, the disaster isn't as total as it might have been.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，当他们走出峡谷时，灾难并没有预想中那么彻底。

sentences.en: And Hannibal is able to lead a squad of cavalry onwards up the roads.
sentences.zh: 汉尼拔得以带领一队骑兵沿着道路继续前进。

sentences.en: And they find the deserted stronghold of the Allabrogues.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了阿洛布罗基人废弃的据点。

sentences.en: And it's deserted because they've all gone off to kind of nick, you know, stuff from the Carthaginian baggage train.
sentences.zh: 之所以废弃，是因为他们都跑去抢劫迦太基的辎重队了。

sentences.en: And here he finds lots of his own men.
sentences.zh: 在这里，他找回了许多自己的部下。

sentences.en: He finds pack animals who've been taken prisoner.
sentences.zh: 他找回了被俘的驮畜。

sentences.en: And he is able, again, to boost the number of cattle and crops.
sentences.zh: 他又一次能够增加牲畜和粮食的数量。

sentences.en: And also, you know, there are large storehouses, cattle, crops, all this kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那里有大型仓库，里面有牲畜、农作物，诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: So, again, he's able to kind of boost his supplies.
sentences.zh: 所以，他又一次能够补充物资。

sentences.en: So it's not all bad.
sentences.zh: 所以情况还不算太糟。

sentences.en: So they rest for a day.
sentences.zh: 于是他们休息了一天。

sentences.en: Then they keep going.
sentences.zh: 然后继续前进。

sentences.en: And they meet another tribe who are a little bit more friendly, who bring them wreaths and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们遇到了另一个部落，对方稍微友好一些，给他们送来了花环之类的东西。

sentences.en: They give him some hostages.
sentences.zh: 他们给了他一些人质。

sentences.en: And then they keep going for another couple of days.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又继续走了几天。

sentences.en: And then, I mean, this is all very reminiscent of Alexander the Great, actually, marching through Persia, through the Zagros Mountains and stuff.
sentences.zh: 而且，我是说，这让人想起亚历山大大帝，他当年穿过波斯，翻越扎格罗斯山脉之类的经历。

sentences.en: Endless kind of gorges and defiles and people waiting for you at the top.
sentences.zh: 无尽的峡谷和隘口，还有人在顶端等着你。

sentences.en: Or Cortez in Mexico, yeah.
sentences.zh: 或者像科尔特斯在墨西哥那样，没错。

sentences.en: And once again, there is another ambush prepared.
sentences.zh: 再一次，又有另一场伏击准备好了。

sentences.en: So they, but this time they're going to be attacked from behind, right?
sentences.zh: 所以他们，但这次他们会从后面受到攻击，对吧？

sentences.en: The Gauls are going to attack them in the rear.
sentences.zh: 高卢人打算从后方袭击他们。

sentences.en: So talk us through that.
sentences.zh: 那给我们讲讲那段吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, again, to quote Polybius.
sentences.zh: 所以，再次引用波利比乌斯的话。

sentences.en: So, again, he says that if this ambush had been successful, then Hannibal's army would have been wiped out.
sentences.zh: 他再次提到，如果这次伏击成功，汉尼拔的军队本会被全歼。

sentences.en: But that Hannibal, you know, he's nervous of what might happen.
sentences.zh: 但汉尼拔，你知道，他很担心可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: And so he'd stationed his mule train and his cavalry at the head of the column and he'd put the heavy infantry at the rear.
sentences.zh: 所以他把骡队和骑兵部署在纵队前方，把重装步兵放在了后方。

sentences.en: So that means that when the barbarians, the Gauls, attack in the rear, they're not able to plunder.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当野蛮人，也就是高卢人，从后方进攻时，他们无法进行掠夺。

sentences.en: They're met with, you know, the stabbing swords of the Spaniards and the spears of the Libyans.
sentences.zh: 他们迎面撞上的是西班牙人的短剑和利比亚人的长矛。

sentences.en: And so Polybius writes, the disaster was less serious than it might have been.
sentences.zh: 因此波利比乌斯写道，灾难比预想的要轻微一些。

sentences.en: But even so, a great number of men, pack animals and horses perished in the attack.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，仍有大量的人员、驮畜和马匹在袭击中丧生。

sentences.en: And the other thing that enables Hannibal to stabilize the situation is that the elephants come into their own at this point.
sentences.zh: 而另一件让汉尼拔能够稳定局势的事情是，大象在此时发挥了关键作用。

sentences.en: The Gauls have never seen anything like them.
sentences.zh: 高卢人从未见过这样的生物。

sentences.en: They're much too scared to approach the stretch of the column where the elephants are marching.
sentences.zh: 他们太害怕了，不敢靠近大象行进的那段纵队。

sentences.en: So actually, the presence of the elephants on this march over the Alps, it redounds to Hannibal's benefit.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，大象在这次翻越阿尔卑斯山的行军中，对汉尼拔是有利的。

sentences.en: It does turn out to have been militarily advantageous.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这在军事上确实是有优势的。

sentences.en: And in time, the attacks of these Gallic warriors start to fade away.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，这些高卢战士的攻击开始减弱。

sentences.en: The sallies by their warriors cease.
sentences.zh: 他们的突袭停止了。

sentences.en: And the boulders that every so often had been kind of rolling down the side of the hill, pushed down by the people ambushing the Carthaginians, they stop dropping.
sentences.zh: 那些不时从山坡上滚落的巨石，那些伏击迦太基人的人推下的石头，也不再落下了。

sentences.en: And the attacks by the natives of the Alps essentially come to an end.
sentences.zh: 阿尔卑斯山原住民的攻击基本上结束了。

sentences.en: But clearly, this has been a hell, you know, Alpine walks go.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这是一场地狱般的经历，你知道，阿尔卑斯山的徒步旅行。

sentences.en: This has been a horror show.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一场恐怖秀。

sentences.en: Hannibal's men are in a miserable state.
sentences.zh: 汉尼拔的部下处于悲惨的状态。

sentences.en: They're shattered.
sentences.zh: 他们精疲力竭。

sentences.en: They're demoralized.
sentences.zh: 他们士气低落。

sentences.en: They've lost friends.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了朋友。

sentences.en: And it's starting to get cold because it's autumn by now.
sentences.zh: 而且天气开始变冷，因为现在已经是秋天了。

sentences.en: They've been climbing the Alps for nine days.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在阿尔卑斯山上攀登了九天。

sentences.en: So the altitude's about 2,000 feet.
sentences.zh: 所以海拔大约有2000英尺。

sentences.en: And so it starts to snow.
sentences.zh: 于是开始下雪了。

sentences.en: And this is very bad news for Hannibal's men, some of whom may, you know, start getting frostbite.
sentences.zh: 这对汉尼拔的部下来说是非常糟糕的消息，其中一些人可能已经开始冻伤了。

sentences.en: But it's also bad news for the horses and particularly for the elephants because there's nothing really for them to eat up there.
sentences.zh: 但这对马匹，尤其是对大象来说也是坏消息，因为山上真的没什么东西可以吃。

sentences.en: So it's a terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 所以情况非常糟糕。

sentences.en: But then at last, Hannibal is able to say, we have reached the summit.
sentences.zh: 但最终，汉尼拔终于可以说：我们到达顶峰了。

sentences.en: And he pitches camp on the summit of the pass.
sentences.zh: 他在山口的顶端扎营。

sentences.en: And he waits there for two days for, you know, all the various stragglers to join him.
sentences.zh: 他在那里等了两天，为了让所有掉队的人赶上来。

sentences.en: And they camp out amid the snow.
sentences.zh: 他们在雪中露营。

sentences.en: Gale screaming all around them.
sentences.zh: 狂风在他们周围呼啸。

sentences.en: It must have been terrible.
sentences.zh: 那一定非常可怕。

sentences.en: But Hannibal's so tough, he doesn't care.
sentences.zh: 但汉尼拔意志坚定，他毫不在意。

sentences.en: And obviously sets an example for the rest of his men in a way that Vin Diesel or Denzel Washington would do as well.
sentences.zh: 显然，他以一种范·迪塞尔或丹泽尔·华盛顿会做的方式，为他的部下树立了榜样。

sentences.en: Or Vince Vaughn.
sentences.zh: 或者像文斯·沃恩那样。

sentences.en: Yeah, or Vince Vaughn or indeed Ian Botham.
sentences.zh: 没错，或者文斯·沃恩，甚至是伊恩·博瑟姆。

sentences.en: But he knows it's not enough for him just to kind of sleep out in the open like everyone else is.
sentences.zh: 但他知道，仅仅像其他人一样露宿野外对他来说是不够的。

sentences.en: He knows he also needs to pet his men up.
sentences.zh: 他知道他还需要鼓舞他的部下。

sentences.en: And so the way he does this, according to Polybius, is that he gathers all his men around him and he gestures out to the Po Valley, you know, Italy, northern Italy, stretching
sentences.zh: 根据波利比乌斯的说法，他这样做的方式是把所有部下召集到身边，指向脚下延伸的波河谷地，也就是意大利，北意大利，

sentences.en: out below him.
sentences.zh: 在他下方展开。

sentences.en: And he says, there it is.
sentences.zh: 他说：看，就在那里。

sentences.en: Rome awaits us.
sentences.zh: 罗马在等待我们。

sentences.en: And there is a problem with this, which actually there isn't a pass from which it's possible to look out from the summit and see Italy.
sentences.zh: 但这里有个问题，实际上并没有哪个山口能让人从顶峰眺望并看到意大利。

sentences.en: That's terrible pedantry from you, Tom.
sentences.zh: 你真是个糟糕的学究，汤姆。

sentences.en: That's shocking pedantry.
sentences.zh: 这学究气太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: Don't...
When you have your meeting with Vin Diesel, don't say this to him.
sentences.zh: 当你和范·迪塞尔会面时，别对他这么说。

sentences.en: No, I'm not going to say it.
sentences.zh: 不，我不会说的。

sentences.en: He will want to hear that there is such a pass.
sentences.zh: 他会想听到确实有这样一个山口。

sentences.en: But I think the gist of the story is true.
sentences.zh: 但我认为故事的要点是真的。

sentences.en: You know, what Hannibal is telling his men is that down there in Italy, you know, we don't have to climb anymore.
sentences.zh: 你知道，汉尼拔告诉他部下的是，在意大利那边，我们不必再攀登了。

sentences.en: We can go down now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在可以下去了。

sentences.en: We have allies waiting to flock to our cause.
sentences.zh: 我们有盟友等着加入我们的事业。

sentences.en: The lands down there are rich in gold and food and women.
sentences.zh: 那里的土地盛产黄金、食物和美女。

sentences.en: And then Polybius tells us he pointed in the direction of Rome itself.
sentences.zh: 然后波利比乌斯告诉我们，他指向了罗马城的方向。

sentences.en: So Italy awaits.
sentences.zh: 所以，意大利在等待。

sentences.en: But obviously there are all kinds of questions still hanging over this expedition.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这次远征仍然悬而未决着各种问题。

sentences.en: How easy will the descent be?
sentences.zh: 下山会容易吗？

sentences.en: Because often, you know, a descent can be at least as challenging as an ascent.
sentences.zh: 因为通常，下山可能至少和上山一样具有挑战性。

sentences.en: What are the Romans?
sentences.zh: 罗马人呢？

sentences.en: Where have they gone?
sentences.zh: 他们去哪了？

sentences.en: What battles will Hannibal face?
sentences.zh: 汉尼拔将面临什么样的战斗？

sentences.en: Will he make it to Rome?
sentences.zh: 他能到达罗马吗？

sentences.en: And Dominic, can people find out about that?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，人们能找到答案吗？

sentences.en: Well, there's only one way to have those questions answered.
sentences.zh: 嗯，只有一个方法可以回答这些问题。

sentences.en: And that is to hear the next episode right away.
sentences.zh: 那就是立刻收听下一集。

sentences.en: Now, the extraordinary innovation that we are pioneering.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们正在开创非凡的创新。

sentences.en: Rolling out, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 我们要开始了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we're rolling it out, I think it's fair to say.
sentences.zh: 没错，我们要开始了，我想这么说很公道。

sentences.en: We've founded a club, would you believe?
sentences.zh: 你敢相信吗，我们成立了一个俱乐部。

sentences.en: It's called the Rest is History Club.
sentences.zh: 它叫“历史余味”俱乐部。

sentences.en: And the great benefit of this club, well, one benefit among many, is that you can hear all the episodes of this series right now.
sentences.zh: 这个俱乐部的一大好处，嗯，众多好处之一，就是你可以立刻收听本系列的所有剧集。

sentences.en: So if you're not already a member of the Rest is History Club, if you're not an early adopter, then you can sign up at therestishistory.com.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你还不是“历史余味”俱乐部的成员，如果你还没成为先行者，那么你可以前往 therestishistory.com 注册。

sentences.en: And you can hear right now what happened when Hannibal came out of the Alps, the great battles, the great dramas that followed.
sentences.zh: 你可以立刻了解到汉尼拔翻越阿尔卑斯山后发生了什么，以及随之而来的伟大战争和宏大剧目。

sentences.en: If for some peculiar and perverse reason of your own, you don't want to join this club, then you can hear what happened on Monday.
sentences.zh: 如果出于某种你自己独特而古怪的原因，你不想加入这个俱乐部，那么你可以在周一收听后续内容。

sentences.en: But why on earth would you wait?
sentences.zh: 但你到底为什么要等呢？

sentences.en: Join the Rest is History Club and find out what happened next in the extraordinary story of Hannibal.
sentences.zh: 加入“历史余味”俱乐部，了解汉尼拔非凡故事的后续发展。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
